findings.title: The engine's commit check allows every unowned vendored change when git runs it from a hook in a linked worktree, and no test runs pre-commit under that environment

extra.claim: Under a hook-exported GIT_DIR, overlay-engine pre-commit returns allow for a staged unowned vendored change in a tree below the git top level, and no test covers that environment for pre-commit
extra.counterevidenceSought: Barter hook does not clear GIT_DIR; status also exits 0 under it; main checkout unaffected; worktrees documented in ai-speckit AGENTS.md:222
extra.alternativeExplanation: Unreachable only if ai-speckit never commits from a linked worktree, which its own workspace rule contradicts
extra.downgradeTrigger: The hook or engine clears GIT_DIR before the probe, or ai-speckit forbids commits from linked worktrees
extra.scopeProof: stagedUnownedChanges is the commit path's only hook-environment top-level probe
